Name: Nonaplic's Jas Redesigns
Author: Nonaplic
Description:
2 small redesigns of Jas, mostly focusing on her portraits.

I thought the original versions of Jas's portraits felt a little odd, so I thought I'd fix them up a bit.
I wasn't sure how to handle the hair though, as her hair looks similar to an afro puff hairstyle in the portraits yet looks more like ponytails in the walking sprites, so I just decided to make two different versions pushing the design more distinctly in either direction. The straight hair/ponytail version of the mod just replaces her portraits while the puffy hair replaces both her portraits and her normal walking sprites.
